description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Lunuwila, Wennappuwa D/S Division, Puttalam District - Cad. Map No. 410001
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, owner information, extent of land, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content is entirely focused on land registration and property ownership matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
